description: Erection of a part first floor side extension, the installation of two air conditioning units to the existing side elevation, internal alterations and changes to existing windows and doors (Listed Building Application)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: P009, P010, P011, P012, P014, P020, P021, P023, P022, P024, P025, P3-111, P3-112, P3-114, P3-115, P3-116, P3-117, P3-120, P3-121, P3-122, P3-123, P3-124, P3-125, PP-12485499v1, Heritage Statement, Flood Risk Assessment Received 07 November 2023.

Condition : 3 - Before the walls of the development hereby permitted are constructed, full details and samples of all materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Details must include a detailed schedule of materials, a photographic sample board, elevations and sections at a sufficient scale (1:20 or 1:50) to illustrate how all external materials will appear together.
The details shall include: 
(a)	Brick/stonework (including brick, stone, masonry, brick panels, feature brick panel, brick framing feature and mortar on-site sample panel, minimum one metre by one metre) including all mortar colours, joint type, brick bond;
(b)	External doors, door frames, window frames, glazing bars, sill and lintel detailing, and means of opening.
The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.
